metaDescription: Join our 2N/3D group departure to Lansdowne — ₹4,999/person all-inclusive with AC transport from Delhi, meals, sightseeing & bonfire DJ night.

itinerary.day: Day 1: Delhi to Lansdowne (Check-in & Evening Music)
itinerary.desc: Board the AC Tempo Traveller from Akshardham Metro Station Delhi (or Noida / Meerut). Enjoy the scenic 260 km drive to Lansdowne. Arrive at Flutter Hotels & Resorts, complete check-in, and enjoy a refreshing welcome drink. Relax in your room. In the evening, enjoy a fun group music session followed by a delicious multi-cuisine dinner.

itinerary.day: Day 2: Lansdowne Local Sightseeing & Bonfire DJ Night
itinerary.desc: Start with a hearty breakfast at the resort. Head out for a guided local sightseeing tour covering Bhulla Tal Lake (boating), Tip-in-Top viewpoint, St. Mary's Church, and Garhwal Rifles War Memorial. Return to resort in evening for group games, bonfire, DJ music, dinner, and overnight stay.

itinerary.day: Day 3: Check-out, Sidhbali Mandir Visit & Return to Delhi
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the resort. On the way back, visit the sacred Sidhbali Mandir in Kotdwar. Continue your comfortable journey back to Delhi, arriving in the evening with cherished mountain memories.

terms: 25% advance payment required at time of booking.
